user_query: I'm researching for a school project on music genres and their evolution. Can you provide me with the top songs from different genres? Also, give me the details of the artists associated with those songs. Additionally, suggest a radio station that showcases a variety of music genres.

TaskList.description: Research and gather information on the top songs from various music genres.
Retrieve details of the artists associated with the top songs obtained from Step 1.
Identify and suggest a radio station that features a variety of music genres.
